summary: Backend-only validation of Iter43-fix24az-w (WhatsApp silent-drops surveillance + alerting). Ran the new 11 pytest cases plus 28 regression tests from q/r/t/v: 39/39 passed. Validated stats defaults, config PUT sanitisation (emails + phones), empty payload rejection (400), pydantic range validation (422), list ordering, test-alert with 0 and N recipients, purge, observer callback (record_and_notify), threshold-triggered alert, cooldown short-circuit and disabled short-circuit. Live curl smoke through REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL confirmed routes are wired (returned 401 as expected because the raw HS256 token needs to map to a real admin user in DB; pytest suite uses the proper auth flow and all endpoints answered 200 there).

JWT_SECRET is 28 bytes — pyjwt emits InsecureKeyLengthWarning. Consider bumping to >=32 bytes.
